text:
alex: follow-up on rate/quotas abuse heuristics after RFC merge. need quick decisions on local vs central scoring, demotion semantics, and scheduler interactions.

sam: local fast heuristics = good for realtime, but must be soft-only. central reconciler does final hard decisions.

priya: +1. soft demote should preserve latency SLO for small requests, reduce QPS and suggest backoff header X-Redwood-Soft-Demotion. hard = 429.

miguel: telemetry requirement: tenant_id, route, decision (allow|soft_demote|hard_reject), reason_tag, origin=(local|central), window_ms. sample traces on demote.

jess: abuse signals list draft: rapid_repeats, large_context_spike, high_token_cost, anonymizer_proxy. sample top-n signals when demoted.

priya: hybrid plan: local heuristic window 100ms-5s => soft demote only; central reconcile every 30s => can escalate to hard after aggregated hits. reduces flapping.

sam: scheduler change: soft_demote => multiply batch_weight by 0.5 and add admission_retry +50ms; hard_reject => immediate 429 bypass. avoids cliff effects.

jess: add oscillator circuit: if tenant toggles >3 times in 60s escalate to provisional hard_reject and alert.

miguel: infra note: metadata extraction must run before local heuristic for multiplexed connections. I'll own adding prefilter hook.

alex: canary plan: 10% pods -> 10 tenants -> 50 tenants. measure 95p latency delta and demote rate; 48h between steps.

infra-bot: canary will be scheduled once runbook + telemetry schema + scheduler PR are ready. telemetry.v2 labels available ~2h post-deploy.

alex: action items: miguel add prefilter + telemetry labels (EOD); priya write runbook + success criteria (Fri COB); sam prototype scheduler weight change (next Wed); jess finalize signals + sampling (Fri). next sync in 48h.

sam: ack.

miguel: :eyes:

jess: will share sampling policy draft.
